en_title: Leonardo DiCaprio and Joaquin Phoenix Were Offered the Role of the Joker in The Dark Knight, But Turned it Down
cn_title: 莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥和华金·菲尼克斯曾获邀在《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》中饰演小丑，但都拒绝了
opus_summary: 选角导演John Papsidera透露，《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》剧本先后送给莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥和杰昆·菲尼克斯，两人均未接演，角色最终由希斯·莱杰出演。菲尼克斯后来在2019年的《小丑》中饰演了另一版本的小丑。

paragraphs.en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Joaquin Phoenix were both offered the role of Joker in The Dark Knight , but ended up turning it down, according to the film's casting director.
paragraphs.cn: 据《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》的选角导演透露，莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥和华金·菲尼克斯都曾获邀在片中饰演小丑，但最终都拒绝了。

paragraphs.en: When speaking at the Nashville Film Festival (via TV Intelligentsia and Batman News ), Christopher Nolan's longtime casting director John Papsidera revealed that Heath Ledger was not the first choice for Joker in The Dark Knight. He said the script was sent to Leonardo DiCaprio first, who apparently didn't even respond. Then, the offer went to Joaquin Phoenix, who would later win an Oscar for the same role in 2019's Joker . Phoenix told Nolan and Papsidera at the time that he wasn't interested in doing big movies and declined the part.
paragraphs.cn: 克里斯托弗·诺兰长期合作的选角导演John Papsidera在Nashville Film Festival上发言时透露，希斯·莱杰并不是《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》中小丑一角的首选（消息经由TV Intelligentsia和Batman News报道）。他说，剧本最先送到了莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥手中，而迪卡普里奥似乎连回应都没有。随后，他们向华金·菲尼克斯发出了邀约，菲尼克斯后来凭借2019年电影《小丑》中的同一角色赢得了奥斯卡奖。菲尼克斯当时告诉诺兰和Papsidera，他对出演大制作电影不感兴趣，并拒绝了这个角色。

paragraphs.en: Eventually, they landed on Heath Ledger, and the rest is history. Leonardo DiCaprio went on to star in Nolan's next project, Inception. The actor also stated last year that The Dark Knight was his favorite Nolan film. Warner Bros. reportedly pressured Nolan and his creative team to cast the Titanic star as The Riddler in the third Batman movie . The team went against this idea, since they typically developed the story for Batman first and then tried to figure out a villain. As a result, Bane made for a more logical villain in a story about an aging Batman who is physically outmatched.
paragraphs.cn: 最终，他们选定了希斯·莱杰，之后的事便人尽皆知。莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥后来主演了诺兰的下一部作品《盗梦空间》。这位演员去年还表示，《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》是他最喜欢的诺兰电影。据报道，华纳兄弟曾向诺兰及其创作团队施压，要求他们让这位《泰坦尼克号》主演在第三部《蝙蝠侠》电影中饰演谜语人。团队没有采纳这个想法，因为他们通常会先构思蝙蝠侠的故事，然后再考虑反派。因此，在一个讲述年迈的蝙蝠侠遭遇体力不敌的对手的故事中，贝恩是更合乎逻辑的反派人选。

paragraphs.en: And as already noted, Phoenix went on to play a completely different version of the Joker. In his two films, Joker is far less calculated. He's more of a guy who stumbles into becoming a symbol for chaos, revolution, and anarchy, though is wildly out of his depth.
paragraphs.cn: 正如前文所述，菲尼克斯后来饰演了一个完全不同版本的小丑。在他的两部电影中，小丑远没有那么工于心计。他更像是一个阴差阳错地成了混乱、革命和无政府主义象征的人，尽管这一切都远远超出了他的能力范围。

paragraphs.en: While it may be difficult to imagine DiCaprio as Joker, it's worth reflecting on who Heath Ledger was before he was cast in the role. He was considered a pretty boy in Hollywood, not unlike DiCaprio, and it was seen as an odd choice to cast the actor for such a villainous role. Phoenix wasn't too far beyond that class of actor, either. It seems like Nolan and Papsidera were intentionally trying to play against type and find someone who could channel an unseen part of themselves.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然可能很难想象迪卡普里奥饰演小丑，但值得回想一下希斯·莱杰在获选出演这个角色之前是什么样的演员。他在好莱坞被视为一个漂亮小生，与迪卡普里奥颇为相似，而让这位演员出演如此邪恶的角色，在当时被认为是个奇怪的选择。菲尼克斯也与这类演员相去不远。诺兰和Papsidera似乎有意打破类型，寻找能够展现自己不为人知一面的演员。
